payload.body: Fixed in d8689e4. Your AppleDouble test was red on a6c99b1, which signed and published the ._ccusage archive, and is green now; the whole bats suite (34 tests) passes, and the live v0.1.5 release still verifies. unpack lists and extracts with bsdtar --options '!mac-ext', so the listing refuses a ._ member and the found-file count is a second guard. Turning mac-ext off showed my own fixtures carrying ._ entries, because files made on this Mac hold com.apple.provenance. ci_release and arm now build with COPYFILE_DISABLE=1, as CI's archives are made, scoped to the fixtures so the handler's own pack is still tested without it. CI's Package executable step now sets COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 too, so a runner image whose files gain extended attributes cannot make archives the signer refuses; GNU tar ignores it.
